lines.japanese: ロッカーの林を抜けると一気に視界が開けた。俺たちはダンスフロアの端、狂乱のほとりに立っていた。
lines.english: Beyond the forest of lockers, the space opened all at once. We stood at the edge of the dance floor, on the shores of delirium.

lines.japanese: 闇の中で青や赤や緑のレーザーライトが無数に行きかい、たゆたうスモークを照らしだしている。妙な甘ったるい香りが漂っているのは、違法な葉っぱの臭いをごまかすためにどこかで香でも焚いているのだろう。
lines.english: Countless blue, red, and green lasers crossed in the darkness, illuminating the drifting smoke. The oddly cloying scent probably came from incense burning somewhere to mask the smell of illicit weed.

lines.japanese: 低音が腹の皮を震わせ、高音が頭の奥に突きささる。暑い、臭い、煙い、うるさい、しかし──どこか胸が躍る。
lines.english: The bass trembled against my belly; the treble stabbed into the back of my skull. Hot, stinking, smoky, deafening—and yet my heart leapt.

lines.japanese: 俺は湧きあがりそうになった高揚感を押しとどめた。遊びに来たわけじゃない。このあとには、朝まで仕事があるんだ。
lines.english: I pressed down the excitement rising inside me. I wasn’t here to have fun. After this, I had a full night’s work ahead of me.

lines.japanese: 「おう！　鳳はどこよ！」
lines.english: “Hey! Where’s Kakeru?”

lines.japanese: ハゲの背中に声を投げつけたが、振りかえりもしないところを見ると届かなかったようだ。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながらフロアを見渡した。
lines.english: I flung my voice at Baldy's back. Since he didn't even turn, it apparently never reached him. Raking at the back of my head, I surveyed the floor.

lines.japanese: 客層はもちろん品のある方々とは言いがたい。男の方が断然多くて、しかもフレイムバーズのメンバーなのか、例の田舎ヤンキーかラッパー気取りみたいなダボついた格好のやつが多かった（トランスに合わねー）。
lines.english: The clientele could hardly be called refined. Men vastly outnumbered women, and a lot of them—Flame Birds members, maybe—wore the same baggy outfits favored by small-town delinquents and wannabe rappers. Not exactly dressed for trance.

lines.japanese: 上を向けば天井には剥き出しのパイプが縦横に走っていて、そのところどころで単眼を閃かせた可動式ライトがロボットの頭みたいにぎこちなく動きまわっていた。
lines.english: Overhead, exposed pipes crisscrossed the ceiling. Here and there, moving lights flashed their single eyes and jerked about like robot heads.

lines.japanese: そのとき、奥のラウンジから歳食ったサーファーみたいなナリをした壮年の店員が駆けよってきた。ハゲの脇に立って、へらへら愛想笑いを浮かべつつ唇を動かしている。
lines.english: Just then, a middle-aged employee who looked like some over-the-hill surfer hurried over from the lounge in back. He stood beside Baldy, mouthing something through a simpering service smile.

lines.japanese: 店員は逆手に掲げたペンライトで丁寧にハゲの足元を照らしつつ、跳ねたり揺れたりフリースタイルで好きなように踊っている若者たちの波をずんずん割って進んだ。
lines.english: The employee held a small flashlight in a reverse grip, carefully lighting the way at Baldy’s feet, and pushed through the tide of young people jumping, swaying, and freestyling however they pleased.

lines.japanese: 混みあった中を三人一列に連なって歩きながら、俺はまたきょろきょろと上下左右を見渡す。
lines.english: As the three of us filed through the crowd, I kept swiveling my head, looking high and low and left and right.

lines.japanese: フロアの一辺はカウンターバーになっていた。そこではグラスを持った複数のカップルが、スタンディングでまったりと語りあっていた。
lines.english: One side of the floor was taken up by a bar. Several couples lingered there with glasses in hand, chatting idly as they stood.

lines.japanese: 正面の壁にはＤＪブースが設けられている。高い窓の向こうで、ヘッドホンを首にかけたそれっぽい男が、恍惚たるさまで体を揺すっていた。
lines.english: A DJ booth was built into the wall ahead. Behind its high window, a man who looked the part swayed in ecstasy, headphones hanging around his neck.

lines.japanese: その横には安っぽいスクリーンが据えられ、幾何学的な模様が二つから四つ、四つから八つへと増殖してゆく退屈な映像が流されていた。
lines.english: Beside him, a cheap screen showed a tedious video of geometric shapes multiplying from two to four, then four to eight.

lines.japanese: けっきょく俺たちはフロアを横断して、ガラスの壁で分断されたＶＩＰルームへ案内された。
lines.english: In the end, we crossed the floor and were shown into a VIP room partitioned behind a glass wall.

lines.japanese: 中はデザイナーズ家具が迎えるラグジュアリーな空間。防音設備もばっちりで、この区画だけがバブル時代のディスコから切りとられてきたみたいだ。
lines.english: Inside was a luxurious space furnished with designer pieces. The soundproofing was perfect; this one section might have been cut whole from a bubble-era disco.

lines.japanese: 場違いに贅沢な部屋の中心で悠々と腰かけていたのは、ラクダみたいな目をした長身の男。嫌味なぐらい長すぎる脚をだらしなく伸ばし、弛緩しきった腕を肘掛けから外へ垂らしていた。
lines.english: Lounging at ease in the center of that incongruously lavish room was a tall man with eyes like a camel's. His offensively long legs sprawled before him, his utterly slack arms dangling over the chair's sides.

lines.japanese: 例の元サーファーみたいな店員は、入口の一歩手前で恭しく頭を下げて早々に立ちさった。俺は部屋じゅう立ちこめるココナツ香の、日焼け止めオイルみたいな匂いに馴染めないでいた。
lines.english: The ex-surfer employee bowed reverently one step short of the entrance and promptly withdrew. I couldn't get used to the coconut scent filling the room, like suntan oil.

lines.japanese: 「ういーっす！　ふぇにっくーす！」
lines.english: “Yo! Phoeeenix!”

lines.japanese: ハゲがチームのハンドサインを見せながら、ずかずか中へ入った。
lines.english: Flashing the team's hand sign, Baldy marched inside.

lines.japanese: 「おい皇帝、見ろよ。珍しい客が来てくれたぜ。おう、成田君」
lines.english: “Hey, Emperor, look who came to see us. Over here, Narita.”

lines.japanese: ハゲが俺に振りむき、もっと近う寄れと手招きする。俺は眉をひそめながら距離を詰めた。なんだ？　いまこいつは、あのベンチに座った男をなんと呼んだ？
lines.english: Baldy turned and beckoned me closer. I closed the distance with a frown. What? What had he just called the man on that couch?

lines.japanese: 「……誰それ」
lines.english: “...Who's that?”

lines.japanese: 弛緩しきった長身を見下ろしながら訊いた。ハゲは空いている席のひとつにどっしり腰を沈めながら、素っ頓狂な声をあげた。
lines.english: I asked, looking down at the tall man’s utterly slack body. Baldy dropped heavily into an empty seat and let out a cry of pure disbelief.

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってんだあんた？　翔くんに決まってんだろ？」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? That's Kakeru, obviously.”

lines.japanese: 「うそお」
lines.english: “No waaay.”

lines.japanese: 俺はその場に排便座りして、ぐったり俯いている男の顔を下から覗きこんだ。
lines.english: I squatted all the way down like I was taking a dump and peered up into the face of the man hanging his head.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 視線がぶつかった。焦点の定まらない目が漂うようにふわふわと笑っていた。たしかに俺の知っている男だった。
lines.english: Our eyes met. His unfocused eyes seemed to float, smiling dreamily. It really was someone I knew.

lines.japanese: 「おお、とり……？」
lines.english: “O...tori?”
“Mmm?”

lines.japanese: 「え、何それ。何してんのおまえ」
lines.english: “What’s with you? What the hell are you doing?”

lines.japanese: そいつは……そいつはあまりに俺の知っているそいつとは纏っている空気が違ったけれど、しかし、紛れもなく俺の知っているそいつ、鳳翔だった。
lines.english: He was—he was nothing like the man I knew. The air about him was utterly different. And yet there was no mistaking him: Kakeru Otori.

lines.japanese: 「なに。どした、酔ってんの」
lines.english: “What happened to you? Drunk?”

lines.japanese: 「んふっ？　酔ってるよ？　俺はいつでもこの世界に悪酔いしてるよ？　ぷぷっ、くっくっく……」
lines.english: “Mm? Sure am. I’m always drunk on this world, and it never agrees with me. Pfft... Heh heh heh...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: なんだ、これは？
lines.english: What was this?

lines.japanese: そこにはあの芝居じみた暑苦しい哄笑も、世のすべてを見下しきった威圧感も、燃えるような瞳の輝きも何もない。これじゃまるで……まるでごく普通のユルユルにいちゃんだ。
lines.english: Gone was the theatrical, overbearing roar of laughter. Gone the pressure of a man who looked down on all creation. Gone the blaze in his eyes. Like this, he was... just some ordinary, laid-back guy.

lines.japanese: 「……なんだおまえ」
lines.english: “...What the hell are you?”

lines.japanese: 「ええー、なんだってぇ？　シュウちゃんこそ何ー」
lines.english: “Whaaat? What'd you say? What are you supposed to be, Shuu-baby?”

lines.japanese: やつはトロリとした流し目で俺を見下ろすと、何事かもごもごと口の中でつぶやいた。
lines.english: He looked down at me with a languid sidelong glance and mumbled something under his breath.

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに？　聞こえねえよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What? Can't hear you.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、うん、驚いたなって。本当に来たんだ。夢遊病？」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. I said I was surprised. You really came. Sleepwalking?”

lines.japanese: 「夢見てんのはてめえだろ。おうニワトリ、目ェ覚ませコラ。鳴け、コケーッて鳴けコケーッて」
lines.english: “You're the one dreaming. Hey, Chicken, wake the hell up. Let's hear you crow. Come on, cock-a-doodle-doo.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳳の頬をぺちぺちと叩いた。やつは腋の下でもくすぐられたみたいに首を曲げて笑う。
lines.english: I patted Otori's cheeks with a few light slaps. He crooked his neck and giggled as though I were tickling him under the arms.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、やめろよー、はっ、ははっ、なんだ隼人か」
lines.english: “Ah ha ha, stop it—hah, ha ha... Oh. It's Hayato.”

lines.japanese: あはは、と来たもんだ。あの大口開けてミュージカルさながらにハーハハハと笑う男が。
lines.english: *Ah ha ha,* he says. The man who normally opened that cavernous mouth and went *HAH-HAH-HAH-HAH* like he was in a musical.

lines.japanese: 「キメえよ、おまえ。人格変わるほど飲んでんじゃねーよ」
lines.english: “You're creepy. Don't drink until your whole personality changes.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの足元から立ちあがり、向かいの席に勢いよくケツを落とした。
lines.english: I rose from my squat at his feet and dropped my ass hard into the seat opposite.

lines.japanese: 「くふふ、べつに飲まなくたって人格変わるひとはいるけどねえ」
lines.english: “Heh heh. Some people change personalities without drinking at all, though.”

lines.japanese: 「うっせえ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: まるで俺たちのことを言ってるみたいだ。俺はテーブルの上にあった蒸しタオルを掴み、鳳めがけ大振りのサイドスローで投げつけた。しかし従順なハゲがやつの前に片手をかざし、たやすくそれを受けとめた。
lines.english: He made it sound as though he meant us. I snatched a hot towel off the table and hurled it at Kakeru in a broad sidearm pitch. His dutiful bald attendant raised one hand before him and caught it with ease.

lines.japanese: 「でー？　今日はどういった風の吹き回し？」
lines.english: “Sooo? What brings you here today?”

lines.japanese: 鳳は腰を浮かせて椅子に浅く座りなおし、長い脚を颯爽と組んだ。玉座にまします不遜な王様みたいで小憎らしい。とろけるような微笑を湛えて、やつはボケボケと言った。
lines.english: Otori lifted himself and resettled near the edge of the chair, crossing his long legs with a flourish. He looked irritatingly like an insolent king enthroned. With a soft, almost melting smile, he went on in a dreamy haze.

lines.japanese: 「やー、まー、用なんかなくてもいいんだけどさあ、どうせ来るなら前もって連絡ほしかったよ。できれば次からはそうしてくれる？」
lines.english: “I mean, you don’t really need a reason. But if you’re coming, I’d appreciate a heads-up. Think you could do that next time?”

lines.japanese: 鳳はいったん隣りのハゲに向き、そこから俺めがけて顎を振りぬいた。命じられた男はすぐに立ちあがると、腹ポケットから名刺入れを取りだし、その中の一枚を両手で俺に差しだしてきた。
lines.english: Kakeru turned first to Baldy beside him, then jerked his chin toward me. The man thus commanded stood at once, produced a card case from his front pocket, and offered me a card in both hands.

lines.japanese: 住所も役職も肩書きもない、名前とケータイ番号だけの味気ないカードだった。俺は舌打ちしながら受けとって、ぞんざいに尻ポケットへ押しこんだ。
lines.english: It was a bland little card with nothing but his name and cell number—no address, position, or title. I clicked my tongue as I took it, then shoved it carelessly into my back pocket.

lines.japanese: 「つか、なんつーかさ」
lines.english: “Anyway, how do I put this...”

lines.japanese: やつは煙草を一本抜きだして唇に挟んだ。自分の席へ向かいかけていたハゲがそれに気付いて、慌てて火を付けに戻った。
lines.english: He drew out a cigarette and set it between his lips. Baldy, already turning back toward his own seat, noticed and hurried over to light it.

lines.japanese: 「隼人に会ってもう一年？　ぼちぼちそんくらいでしょ？　今更こんなんで会うっつーのも、ねえ、正直かなりこっぱずかしいんですけど」
lines.english: “It’s been what, a year since I met you, Hayato? About that long, right? Having you see me like this only now... yeah, honestly, it’s pretty damn embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: ちょっと無愛想な、だけどどこにでもいる若者みたいな口ぶりで煙草を吹かす。ラクダみたいな笑顔を紫煙が取りまいていた。
lines.english: He smoked with the slightly aloof manner of an ordinary young man you could meet anywhere. Purple smoke gathered around his camel smile.

lines.japanese: 「でも、どのみち潮時近かったし、まあいいか。改めましてこんばんは、鳳翔でーす。なんつって、いぇい、いぇい」
lines.english: “But it was about time either way, so whatever. Good evening once again. Kakeru Otori here. Or something. Yay, yay.”

lines.japanese: 調子狂う。まるで別人を相手にしてるみたいだ。どれだけ飲んだんだろう。俺はアルコール類の空瓶を探して軽く周囲を見回したが、低いテーブルの上にコーヒー色のグラスがひとつ載っているだけだった。
lines.english: He threw me completely off my stride. It was like facing a different person. How much had he drunk? I glanced around for empty bottles, but all the low table held was one coffee-brown glass.

lines.japanese: 「あの、おまえ、マジで大丈夫か」
lines.english: “Hey. Are you seriously okay?”

lines.japanese: 「おっけー、あいむふぁいん！　ひゃっはー、ぶりぶりー！」
lines.english: “Okaaay, I’m fine! Yee-haw! High as a kite!”

lines.japanese: うん。どうやら大丈夫じゃなさそうだな。
lines.english: Right. Apparently he wasn't okay.

lines.japanese: 「……ま、いいや。あんさ、俺、おまえに忠告しに来たんだけど」
lines.english: “...Whatever. Listen, I came to warn you.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なにー？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: やつは長椅子の端に寄って、肘掛けに頬杖をついた。俺はわざわざここまで赴いたことを少し後悔しながら、腕を組んで両足をテーブルに載せた。
lines.english: He slid to one end of the couch and propped his cheek on the armrest. Slightly regretting that I'd come all this way, I folded my arms and planted both feet on the table.

lines.japanese: 「Ｒ－ウィングの大司教──あの、この前ガード下でおまえにブッ放したオウム頭の女装男。覚えてるよな」
lines.english: “R-Wing's Archbishop—the cross-dressing parrot-head who opened fire on you under the tracks the other day. You remember him.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、うん、あの宗教がかってる子ね」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. The culty kid.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、そいつ。そいつだけど、アレいま超テンパってて見境なくなってるから──」
lines.english: “Right, him. He’s so wound up he can’t see straight, so—”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そりゃねえ、マジもんのヤーさんに本気で追っかけられたら誰だって」
lines.english: “Well, sure. Anyone would panic with real gangsters hunting them in earnest.”
“—What?”

lines.japanese: 鳳は丸く開けた口を天井に向けて、ぷかぷかとドーナツ型の煙を吹いた。
lines.english: Otori tipped his O-shaped mouth toward the ceiling and puffed out a smoke ring.

lines.japanese: 「なに。知ってたの」
lines.english: “What? You knew?”

lines.japanese: 「たまたまね。そういう情報に詳しいおっちゃんが、たまたま身近にいるもんで」
lines.english: “By chance. I happen to know an older guy who’s plugged into that kind of information.”

lines.japanese: 咥え煙草で、やつは形の良いつるつるの顎をさする。髭自慢の男がよくやる仕草だ。俺は続けた。
lines.english: Cigarette between his lips, he stroked his smooth, finely shaped chin—the gesture of a man proud of his beard. I went on.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、あのカマが、まだおまえのこと狙ってんのも知ってんの」
lines.english: “Then do you know that queen is still after you?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、俺？　ああ、そうなの？」
lines.english: “Me? Oh. Is he?”

lines.japanese: 「そうなの。Ｒ－ウィングの仲間には見放されたけど、帰るとこなくしたってんで、逆におまえと刺しちがえる覚悟バリバリなの」
lines.english: “He is. R-Wing abandoned him, and now he’s got no home to go back to. If anything, he’s more determined than ever to die taking you with him.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、恐いね。つか、そっちこそ詳しいじゃん」
lines.english: “Huh. Scary. You're pretty well informed yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「まァ、俺はインターネットの達人だからな」
lines.english: “Well, I'm a master of the internet.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん」
lines.english: “Hm.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は煙を吸いこみながら横のハゲに目配せした。ハゲは重々しく立ちあがると、携帯電話を耳に当てながら部屋の隅へ移動した。おそらくフレイムバーズの連中に警戒を呼びかけるんだろう。
lines.english: Drawing in smoke, Otori flicked a glance at Baldy beside him. Baldy rose ponderously, put a cell phone to his ear, and moved into a corner. Presumably he was warning the other Flame Birds to be on guard.

lines.japanese: 「にしても、あいつ、ほんと馬鹿だよなあ」
lines.english: “Still, that guy really is an idiot.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、その大司教ってやつ。俺の周りなんてうろついてたって全然いいことないんだからさ、さっさとどっかの農村にでも引っこみゃいいのに」
lines.english: “I mean the Archbishop. Nothing good is ever going to happen while he hangs around me. He ought to go hole up in some farming village.”

lines.japanese: 「んな余裕ぶっこいてる場合かよ。狙われてンのはおまえなんだぞ」
lines.english: “This is no time to act so cocky. You’re the one he’s after.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、悪いけど俺、あいつに負ける気しないんだよねえ。こっちには頼もしいＳＰも付いてるし」
lines.english: “Mm. Sorry, but I can't see myself losing to him. Besides, I've got a dependable bodyguard.”

lines.japanese: ねー、と言ってやつはハゲめがけ首を横に倒した。大男は電話口の誰かと話しながら、ハイハイと酔っ払い相手のおざなりな相槌を打った。
lines.english: “Right?” he added, tipping his head toward Baldy. Still talking to somebody on the phone, the giant gave the perfunctory *yeah, yeah* of a man humoring a drunk.

lines.japanese: 「とかヨユーかましてッと、不意打たれるかもしんねえだろ。おまえ、ほとぼり冷めるまで、ひと気のないとこ歩かねえ方がいいぞ。あと逆に、混みあってて妙なやつの接近に気付けねえとことか──」
lines.english: “Keep acting like you've got nothing to fear and he might catch you off guard. Until this blows over, stay out of deserted places. Then again, stay out of crowds where you couldn't spot some creep coming up on you—”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、ちょっと聞くけどさ。それって俺のこと心配してんの？」
lines.english: “Hey, let me ask you something. Are you worried about me?”

lines.japanese: 俺の言葉を、鳳は途中で遮った。不思議そうなツラでじっとこっちを見ている。釈迦に説法とでも言いたいんだろうか。
lines.english: Otori cut me off and stared at me as if genuinely puzzled. Did he think I was preaching to the Buddha?

lines.japanese: 「……悪りいかよ」
lines.english: “...You got a problem with that?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、逆」
lines.english: “The opposite.”

lines.japanese: 小さく開いた唇の隙間から白い煙が漏れでた。
lines.english: White smoke escaped through the narrow parting of his lips.

lines.japanese: 「あんがと」
lines.english: “Thanks.”

lines.japanese: とことんだ。とことん調子狂う。
lines.english: This was getting ridiculous. He had me completely off balance.

lines.japanese: 「俺の方は大丈夫だと思うよ。それより、そっちこそ気を付けた方がいいんじゃない？」
lines.english: “I think I'll be fine. More importantly, shouldn't *you* be careful?”

lines.japanese: 「なに。なんで俺が」
lines.english: “What? Why me?”

lines.japanese: 「だってそいつ切羽詰まってんでしょ。フェニックスが無理ならせめてハヤブサを、って考えるかもよ」
lines.english: “You said he's desperate. If Phoenix is out of reach, he might settle for Falcon.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそりゃ。意味わかんねえ。つか、フェニックスって誰だよニワトリ」
lines.english: “What the hell does that mean? And who's Phoenix, Chicken?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: それから鳳は煙草を揉みけしながら言った。
lines.english: Then Otori crushed out his cigarette and said:

lines.japanese: 「なんか飲む、ファルコン？」
lines.english: “Want a drink, Falcon?”

lines.japanese: 何がファルコンだ。俺は首を横に振った。これから仕事だってある。やつは「ちぇ」と言いながら、ガラスの向こうに合図して店員を呼びつけた。
lines.english: Falcon, my ass. I shook my head. I still had work ahead of me. With a disappointed click of his tongue, he signaled through the glass and summoned an employee.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ帰るわ」
lines.english: “I'm going home.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。また来てね。次はもっと突っこんだ話をしてあげるから」
lines.english: “Okay. Come back sometime. Next time, I’ll go into a little more detail.”

lines.japanese: 俺が出入り口の扉へ向かうと、やつは恋人を送りだす女みたいなことを言った。しかし冗談にしては妙に含みのある物言いだった。俺は無言で、肩越しに少しだけ振りかえった。
lines.english: As I headed for the door, he said it like a woman seeing her lover off. Yet for a joke, the words carried a strangely suggestive weight. Without a word, I glanced back over my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「次は俺たちの話をしよう」
lines.english: “Next time, let's talk about us.”

lines.japanese: なんだ。なんの話をすると言うんだ。くだらない。俺は返事をしなかった。
lines.english: What? What was there to talk about? Ridiculous. I gave him no answer.

lines.japanese: ガラスの温室の外は、もう冬だってのに半袖Ｔシャツの男や薄いキャミソールの女で満たされていた。
lines.english: Outside that glass hothouse, though winter had already come, the floor was full of men in short-sleeved T-shirts and women in flimsy camisoles.

lines.japanese: シンプルなキックに合わせて垂直に揺れる剥き出しの肩や、グルーヴィにうねるローライズのケツに弾かれながら、俺はダンスフロアを横切って店を出た。
lines.english: Buffeted by bare shoulders bobbing straight up and down to the simple kick and low-rise asses rolling to the groove, I crossed the dance floor and left the club.

lines.japanese: 出てきた俺の姿を見て、あの受付係のモテ髭がまたその場に額づいた。すいませんした、すいませんした。
lines.english: At the sight of me emerging, Goatee dropped into another bow so deep his forehead touched the floor. *Sorry, sir. Sorry, sir.*

lines.japanese: も、ええっつーの。
lines.english: Enough already.

lines.japanese: 「ふわあ～あ」
lines.english: “Yaaawn...”

lines.japanese: 地上に戻った俺は、薄紫の空の下でまた大口を開けた。
lines.english: Back aboveground, I opened my mouth wide again beneath a pale-violet sky.

lines.japanese: どうせ誰にも聞こえやしないと思ってでかい声をあげたのに、はす向かいのビルの隅で佇んでいた男がびくりと身をすくませた。
lines.english: I’d made the yawn loud because I figured nobody could hear it. But a man lingering by the corner of the building diagonally across the street flinched and drew into himself.

lines.japanese: 俺は下を向きながら、漏れたあくびを掴りつぶすように口へ蓋をした。相手も気まずかったのか、頭に載っていたしわくちゃのチューリップ帽をさらに深く引きおろしていた。
lines.english: Looking down, I covered my mouth as if crushing the escaped yawn in my fist. Maybe he was embarrassed too; he pulled his wrinkled tulip hat even lower.

lines.japanese: こんな寒い夜にひとりで、どっかのホステスの出待ちでもしてるんだろうか。ご苦労さまだ。その報われぬ愛、いつか実るといいですね。
lines.english: Was he waiting alone on a freezing night for some hostess to get off work? My, how devoted. May that unrequited love of yours bear fruit someday.

lines.japanese: 俺はもう一回大あくびをしながら、あの高速道路の橋の下を目指して歩きだした。
lines.english: Yawning hugely once more, I set off toward the bridge beneath the expressway.

lines.japanese: 十数歩の距離を進んだあたりで、ふと気になった。
lines.english: A dozen or so paces later, something nagged at me.

lines.japanese: あれ……あの帽子、最近どっかで見たか？
lines.english: Wait... Had I seen that hat somewhere recently?

lines.japanese: 俺はちょろっと振りかえってみた。だがそこには、すでに男の姿がなかった。
lines.english: I took a quick look back. The man was already gone.

lines.japanese: きっと、愛しのお姫様に渡すとっておきの花束でも買いに行ったんだろう。それとも、べつの店から出てきた素敵なお姫様に心変わりしたのかもしれない。
lines.english: Surely he’d gone to buy the perfect bouquet for his beloved princess. Or maybe some other lovely princess had stepped out of another club and turned his head.

lines.japanese: 関係ないやと思うことにした。
lines.english: I decided it had nothing to do with me.

lines.japanese: そして俺は現場へ向かった。
lines.english: Then I headed for the work site.
